title: Locate an Exact Sorted Record
prerequisite: Array indexing and explicit loop invariants.
hints: Compare the target with the middle value. Sorted order proves that one entire half cannot contain the target.
Choose a precise search interval—such as inclusive low and high indices—and preserve that meaning on every update.
Return the midpoint on equality; otherwise move low above mid or high below mid, and return -1 when the interval is empty.
